4590-4594-7070.notablePrerequisites: You have attacked 2 or more opponents this turn.
4590-4594-7070.description:
Activate Spirit en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Spirit en-Kor.
The Spirit en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Spirit en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Commander Liara Portyr.
Repeat.

240-574-5295-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.
240-574-5295-5470.notes: Depending on how many counters this combo puts on Vish Kal, you can activate its last ability to kill some number of creatures.

1339-4616-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-4616-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1453-3967-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1453-3967-4694-7306.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving them indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

628-2921--5.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

2438-7084-7885.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Down in the Valley triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2438-3081-3817-7772.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Valiant Changeling.
When Valiant Changeling dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Valiant Changeling from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

413-2178-7185-7284.description:
Cast Belonging by paying {5}{W}.
When Belonging enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Belonging trigger, creating three 1/1 Shapeshifter creature tokens with changeling.
When the Shapeshifters enter, Blasting Station triggers three times. Resolve all Blasting Station triggers from this step and step 2, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Belonging.
When Belonging dies, Rat King triggers, untapping Rat King.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate Rat King by tapping it and sacrificing the Shapeshifters.
When the Shapeshifters die, Rat King triggers three times, untapping Rat King.
Resolve the Rat King ability from step 5, returning Belonging from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

147-5686-7335.description:
Cast Pain 101 by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Pain 101, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Pain 101.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Shilgengar abilities from step 5.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7231.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two creature cards in all graveyards.
3967-6972-7231.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Drakestown Forgotten.
When Drakestown Forgotten dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1946-2510-7070.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
1946-2510-7070.description:
Activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Nomads en-Kor.
The Nomads en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Nomads en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Semblance Anvil.
Repeat.

1286-5147-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1844-5571-6798--6.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is 2 or greater.
1844-5571-6798--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 2.

339-677-997-5295.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature with Mana Cost Equal to {0}

3000-3182-3676-5751--1.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
3000-3182-3676-5751--1.description:
Cast the creature with mana cost {0} from your graveyard for its retrace cost by discarding a land card.
Tangleroot and Turntimber Sower trigger.
Resolve the Tangleroot trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Turntimber Sower trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 0/1 Plant creature token.
Activate Turntimber Sower by paying {G}, sacrificing the {0} cost creature, the Squirrel and the Plant, returning a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3440-4867-5686-6809.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant or sorcery spells.
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying {1}{B}, targeting Cormela.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cormela.
When Cormela dies, it triggers twice and Scion of Opulence triggers once.
Resolve the Scion of Opulence trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the first Cormela trigger, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second Cormela trigger, returning Demonic Gifts from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 3.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1274-3490-5231-6719.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-5231-6719.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more charge counters on it

2593-4067-6100-6281.description:
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Elvish Regrower.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Elvish Regrower that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Elvish Regrower token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Elvish Regrower from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat.

1251-1563-2457-4094.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1251-1563-2457-4094.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1495-2060-2921-5544-6431.manaNeeded: {B} if Crystalline Crawler does not have a +1/+1 counter on it
1495-2060-2921-5544-6431.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
If able, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Triskelion ability from step 3.
Repeat.

3017-4869-6092.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
3017-4869-6092.description:
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding a card.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to draw that many cards.
Resolve the Ghostly Pilferer ability.
Repeat.

293-549-3698-5220.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Narcomoeba, targeting yourself.
When Narcomoeba dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Narcomoeba on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability, causing you to mill three cards.
Narcomoeba triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Narcomoeba enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Repeat.

323-2530-2577-2899.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Gravecrawler enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Carnival of Souls and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

429-3583-4067.description:
Activate Pristine Talisman by tapping it, adding {C} and causing you to gain 1 life.
Oloro's first ability triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Pristine Talisman.
Repeat.

5109-5183.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to you and target creature, and causing you to gain life equal to the total amount of damage done this way.

1059-3398.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least six other creatures that can attack this turn.
An opponent is unable to block and kill your creatures.
1059-3398.description:
Declare Radha, Hellkite Charger and at least six other creatures as attackers.
Radha and Hellkite Charger trigger.
Resolve the Radha trigger, adding at least {6}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, choosing to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

202-335.description:
Cast Ad Nauseam by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Resolve Ad Nauseam, revealing the top card of your library, putting that card into your hand and losing life equal to that card's mana value.
Repeat the process in step 2 as many times as desired.

738-1969-5004-5256.description:
Sacrifice Cathodion to Altar of Dementia.
Cathodion and Grave Pact trigger.
Resolve Cathodion's trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Grave Pact's trigger, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Cathodion to your hand.
Resolve Altar of Dementia's ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Cast Cathodion by paying {3}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.
